title: MSME or Udyam Registration in India
description: We offer assistance in obtaining Udyam Registration for your MSME quickly and easily. Our services include filing for MSME Registration with the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, enabling you to avail numerous incentives, benefits, and concessions as a registered MSME.

data.description: MSMEs (Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises) play a crucial role in the growth and development of the Indian economy. To support and encourage the growth of MSMEs, the government of India offers various benefits and incentives such as priority sector lending, tax exemptions, and subsidies. To avail these benefits, MSMEs need to register themselves with the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises. The registration process has been simplified and replaced by Udyam Registration since July 1, 2020. Udyam Registration is an online process that enables MSMEs to register themselves easily and quickly, and obtain a lifetime registration certificate.

title: Startup India Registration
description: We offer assistance in obtaining recognition under the Startup India Scheme by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT). This recognition provides startups with various benefits and concessions in Intellectual Property (IP) filing. Our services include drafting the necessary documents and filing the application with DPIIT (Government of India) on behalf of the startup.

data.description: The Startup India Scheme is a flagship initiative of the Indian government launched in January 2016 with the aim of promoting and supporting startups in the country. The scheme provides various benefits and concessions to startups such as tax exemptions, funding opportunities, and mentorship support. To avail of the benefits under the scheme, startups need to register with DPIIT. The registration process involves filling out an online application form and submitting the necessary documents to DPIIT. Once registered, startups become eligible for various benefits under the scheme. Some of the benefits include tax exemptions for the first three years, faster patent filing and examination, access to funding through the Startup India Fund of Funds, and a dedicated helpline to address queries and grievances. Startups can also avail of various other incentives such as fee waivers for government services, easier compliance procedures, and access to a network of mentors and investors.

data.title: Key benefits of Startup India Registration
Tax benefits for 3 out of 7 years
Access to funding support from government-approved funds
Easy winding up of the company within 90 days
Eligibility for tax exemptions for capital gains
Access to a dedicated startup portal and mobile app
Simplified compliance for environmental and labour laws
Access to incubation centers and mentorship programs.

eligibility.name: Minimum Requirement
eligibility.heading: To register a startup under the Startup India Scheme, the minimum requirements are as follows

data.description: The startup should be a Private Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or a Limited Liability Partnership (LLP).
The age of the startup should not exceed 10 years from the date of incorporation or registration.
The turnover of the startup should be less than INR 100 crores in any of the previous financial years.
The startup should be working towards innovation, development, deployment, or commercialization of new products, processes, or services driven by technology or intellectual property.

In addition to the above requirements, the startup should also provide the necessary documents such as the Certificate of Incorporation/Registration, a brief write-up about the business model, and a pitch deck while applying for recognition under the Startup India Scheme.

benefits.name: Benefits
benefits.heading: The Startup India Scheme is a flagship initiative of the Indian government launched in January 2016 with the aim of promoting and supporting startups in the country. Startup India Scheme provides various benefits and incentives to startups, making it easier for them to start and grow their businesses in India. The scheme aims to create a supportive ecosystem for startups and promote entrepreneurship and innovation in the country. The scheme provides various benefits and concessions to startups such as:

data.title: Tax benefits
data.description: Startups registered under the Startup India Scheme are eligible for various tax benefits. They are exempted from paying income tax for the first three years of their operations, provided they have been incorporated after April 1, 2016. This helps startups to allocate more resources towards business growth and development.

data.title: Faster patent filing and examination
data.description: Startups registered under the Startup India Scheme can avail of faster patent filing and examination through the expedited examination of patent applications. The scheme aims to reduce the time taken for the patent examination process from the usual 5-7 years to just 2-4 months. This helps startups to protect their intellectual property and gain a competitive advantage in the market.

data.title: Access to funding opportunities
data.description: Startups registered under the Startup India Scheme can access various funding opportunities through the Startup India Fund of Funds. The fund provides startups with financial assistance through various channels such as venture capital funds, angel networks, and incubators. This funding support helps startups to overcome the initial funding barrier and access the capital required for growth and expansion.

data.title: Simplified compliance procedures
data.description: Startups registered under the Startup India Scheme enjoy simplified compliance procedures, making it easier for them to operate and grow their businesses. They are exempted from certain labor laws and regulations for the first three years, making it easier for them to hire employees and focus on their core business activities.

data.title: Networking opportunities
data.description: Startups registered under the Startup India Scheme can access a network of mentors, investors, and other entrepreneurs. This helps startups to learn from experienced professionals, gain exposure to new ideas, and expand their business networks.

data.title: Government support
data.description: Startups registered under the Startup India Scheme can avail of various government services and facilities such as incubation centers, research parks, and startup hubs. The government also provides a dedicated helpline to address queries and grievances of startups.

data.title: What is Startup India registration?
data.description: Startup India registration is a process through which a startup can apply for recognition and avail benefits offered by the Indian Government under the Startup India Scheme.

data.title: What are the benefits of Startup India registration?
data.description: The benefits of Startup India registration include tax exemptions, easier access to funding, self-certification compliance, faster exit process, and more.

data.title: Who is eligible for Startup India registration?
data.description: Startups that are less than 10 years old and have an annual turnover of less than Rs 100 crores are eligible for Startup India registration.

data.title: What are the documents required for Startup India registration?
data.description: The documents required for Startup India registration include Certificate of Incorporation/Registration, PAN Card, Address proof, and a brief description of the business.

data.title: How long does it take to complete the Startup India registration process?
data.description: The Startup India registration process can take anywhere from 7 to 21 working days, depending on the accuracy and completeness of the application and supporting documents.

data.title: Is there any fee for Startup India registration?
data.description: No, there is no fee for Startup India registration. The registration process is free of cost.

data.title: Can a foreign national apply for Startup India registration?
data.description: Yes, a foreign national can apply for Startup India registration. However, the startup should be incorporated as a Private Limited Company or a Limited Liability Partnership in India.

data.title: What is the validity period of Startup India recognition?
data.description: The Startup India recognition is valid for 10 years from the date of incorporation of the startup.

data.title: Can an existing startup apply for Startup India registration?
data.description: Yes, an existing startup can apply for Startup India registration. However, the startup should meet the eligibility criteria and provide the required documents to apply for recognition.
